enrichment.headline: Pays P&A Administrative Services up to $270,000 to run employee benefit accounts through 2025
enrichment.summary: The district is hiring P&A Administrative Services, Inc. of Buffalo, NY to administer its Flexible Spending Account, dependent care, transit, COBRA and billing services for employees. The cost can be no more than $90,000 per year and $270,000 over the whole term, March 1, 2022 through June 30, 2025.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays Anthonio, Inc. up to $311,987 to inspect construction at the Laurel Child Development Center
enrichment.summary: The district hires Anthonio, Inc. of Oakland as the inspector of record during construction of the Laurel Child Development Center. The inspector writes daily reports, a punch list and the paperwork to close out the project with the Division of the State Architect (DSA). The limit of $311,987 includes $28,362 for additional services, and the work runs from February 24, 2022 to February 24, 2025.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $16,775 for ACC Environmental's asbestos and lead surveys at more Claremont Middle School buildings
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds $16,775 to the agreement with ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc. of Oakland, raising the contract limit from $7,260 to $24,035. The added money pays for asbestos and lead surveys and reports for more buildings on the Claremont Middle School campus, and includes $1,525 for additional services. It also extends the end date from January 31, 2022 to December 31, 2022.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
